verses.original: Εἶχε μὲν οὖν καὶ ἡ πρώτη δικαιώματα λατρείας τό τε ἅγιον κοσμικόν
verses.transliteration: Eiche men oun kai hē prōtē dikaiōmata latreias to te hagion kosmikon
verses.literal: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Até a primeira aliança, na verdade, teve as suas ordenanças de serviço sagrado e o seu santuário terrestre.

verses.original: σκηνὴ γὰρ κατεσκευάσθη ἡ πρώτη ἐν ᾗ ἥ τε λυχνία καὶ ἡ τράπεζα καὶ ἡ πρόθεσις τῶν ἄρτων ἥτις λέγεται Ἅγια
verses.transliteration: skēnē gar kateskeuasthē hē prōtē en hē hē te lychnia kai hē trapeza kai hē prothesis tōn artōn hētis legetai Hagia
verses.literal: A tabernacle was prepared In its first room were the lampstand the table and the consecrated bread This was called the Holy Place
verses.literalPt: Pois havia um tabernáculo preparado, o primeiro em que estava o candeeiro, e a mesa, e os pães da proposição, e este se chama o Santo Lugar;

verses.original: μετὰ δὲ τὸ δεύτερον καταπέτασμα σκηνὴ ἡ λεγομένη Ἅγια ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: meta de to deuteron katapetasma skēnē hē legomenē Hagia hagiōn
verses.literal: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place . . .
verses.literalPt: mas, atrás do segundo véu, o tabernáculo que se chama o Santo dos Santos,

verses.original: χρυσοῦν ἔχουσα θυμιατήριον καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης περικεκαλυμμένην πάντοθεν χρυσίῳ ἐν ᾗ στάμνος χρυσῆ ἔχουσα τὸ μάννα καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος Ἀαρὼν ἡ βλαστήσασα καὶ αἱ πλάκες τῆς διαθήκης
verses.transliteration: chrysoun echousa thymiatērion kai tēn kibōton tēs diathēkēs perikekalymmenēn pantothen chrysiō en hē stamnos chrysē echousa to manna kai hē rhabdos Aarōn hē blastēsasa kai hai plakes tēs diathēkēs
verses.literal: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered . . . . . . ark of the covenant Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna Aaron’s staff that had budded and the stone tablets of the covenant
verses.literalPt: tendo um altar de ouro para o incenso e a arca da aliança, coberta de ouro ao redor por todas as partes, na qual estava um vaso de ouro, que continha o maná, e a vara de Arão, que brotou, e as tábuas da aliança,

verses.original: ὑπεράνω δὲ αὐτῆς Χερουβὶν δόξης κατασκιάζοντα τὸ ἱλαστήριον περὶ ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν νῦν λέγειν κατὰ μέρος
verses.transliteration: hyperanō de autēs Cheroubin doxēs kataskiazonta to hilastērion peri hōn ouk estin nyn legein kata meros
verses.literal: Above the ark were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat But we cannot discuss these things in detail now
verses.literalPt: e, por cima dela, os querubins de glória, que cobriam o propiciatório, das quais coisas não é oportuno, agora, falar individualmente.

verses.original: Τούτων δὲ οὕτως κατεσκευασμένων εἰς μὲν τὴν πρώτην σκηνὴν διὰ παντὸς εἰσίασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὰς λατρείας ἐπιτελοῦντες
verses.transliteration: Toutōn de houtōs kateskeuasmenōn eis men tēn prōtēn skēnēn dia pantos eisiasin hoi hiereis tas latreias epitelountes
verses.literal: When everything had been prepared in this way the priests entered regularly . . . into the first room to perform their sacred duties
verses.literalPt: Preparadas assim essas coisas, entram continuamente no primeiro tabernáculo os sacerdotes, para celebrar os serviços sagrados,

verses.original: εἰς δὲ τὴν δευτέραν ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ μόνος ὁ ἀρχιερεύς οὐ χωρὶς αἵματος ὃ προσφέρει ὑπὲρ ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ ἀγνοημάτων
verses.transliteration: eis de tēn deuteran hapax tou eniautou monos ho archiereus ou chōris haimatos ho prospherei hyper heautou kai tōn tou laou agnoēmatōn
verses.literal: But only the high priest entered the second room and then only once a year and never without blood which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance
verses.literalPt: mas, no segundo, entra, a sós, o sumo sacerdote, uma vez por ano, não sem sangue, que oferece por si e pelas ignorâncias do povo,

verses.original: Τοῦτο δηλοῦντος τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου μήπω πεφανερῶσθαι τὴν τῶν ἁγίων ὁδὸν ἔτι τῆς πρώτης σκηνῆς ἐχούσης στάσιν
verses.transliteration: Touto dēlountos tou Pneumatos tou Hagiou mēpō pephanerōsthai tēn tōn hagiōn hodon eti tēs prōtēs skēnēs echousēs stasin
verses.literal: By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing
verses.literalPt: significando, com isso, o Espírito Santo que o caminho do Santo lugar não se tem manifestado, enquanto subsiste o primeiro tabernáculo,

verses.original: ἥτις παραβολὴ εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τὸν ἐνεστηκότα καθ’ ἣν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίαι προσφέρονται μὴ δυνάμεναι κατὰ συνείδησιν τελειῶσαι τὸν λατρεύοντα
verses.transliteration: hētis parabolē eis ton kairon ton enestēkota kath’ hēn dōra te kai thysiai prospherontai mē dynamenai kata syneidēsin teleiōsai ton latreuonta
verses.literal: It is an illustration for the present time because the gifts and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse . . . the conscience of the worshiper
verses.literalPt: o qual é uma parábola para o tempo presente, conforme a qual se oferecem tanto dons como sacrifícios, que não podem, quanto à consciência, tornar perfeito o adorador,

verses.original: μόνον ἐπὶ βρώμασιν καὶ πόμασιν καὶ διαφόροις βαπτισμοῖς δικαιώματα σαρκὸς μέχρι καιροῦ διορθώσεως ἐπικείμενα
verses.transliteration: monon epi brōmasin kai pomasin kai diaphorois baptismois dikaiōmata sarkos mechri kairou diorthōseōs epikeimena
verses.literal: They consist only in food and drink and special washings external regulations imposed until the time of reform
verses.literalPt: sendo somente (com comidas e bebidas e várias abluções) umas ordenanças da carne impostas até um tempo de reforma.

verses.original: Χριστὸς δὲ παραγενόμενος ἀρχιερεὺς τῶν γενομένων ἀγαθῶν διὰ τῆς μείζονος καὶ τελειοτέρας σκηνῆς οὐ χειροποιήτου τοῦτ’ ἔστιν οὐ ταύτης τῆς κτίσεως
verses.transliteration: Christos de paragenomenos archiereus tōn genomenōn agathōn dia tēs meizonos kai teleioteras skēnēs ou cheiropoiētou tout’ estin ou tautēs tēs ktiseōs
verses.literal: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation
verses.literalPt: Mas Cristo, tendo vindo como sumo sacerdote dos bens já realizados, por meio do maior e mais perfeito tabernáculo, não feito por mãos de homens, isto é, não desta criação,

verses.original: οὐδὲ δι’ αἵματος τράγων καὶ μόσχων διὰ δὲ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος εἰσῆλθεν ἐφάπαξ εἰς τὰ ἅγια αἰωνίαν λύτρωσιν εὑράμενος
verses.transliteration: oude di’ haimatos tragōn kai moschōn dia de tou idiou haimatos eisēlthen ephapax eis ta hagia aiōnian lytrōsin heuramenos
verses.literal: He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves but He entered . . . the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood thus securing eternal redemption
verses.literalPt: nem pelo sangue de bodes e bezerros, mas pelo seu próprio sangue, entrou, uma vez para sempre, no Santo Lugar, havendo obtido uma redenção eterna.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ τὸ αἷμα τράγων καὶ ταύρων καὶ σποδὸς δαμάλεως ῥαντίζουσα τοὺς κεκοινωμένους ἁγιάζει πρὸς τὴν τῆς σαρκὸς καθαρότητα
verses.transliteration: Ei gar to haima tragōn kai taurōn kai spodos damaleōs rhantizousa tous kekoinōmenous hagiazei pros tēn tēs sarkos katharotēta
verses.literal: For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean
verses.literalPt: Pois, se o sangue de bodes e de touros e as cinzas de uma novilha, aspergidos sobre os contaminados, os santificam para a purificação da carne,

verses.original: πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ αἷμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὃς διὰ Πνεύματος αἰωνίου ἑαυτὸν προσήνεγκεν ἄμωμον τῷ Θεῷ καθαριεῖ τὴν συνείδησιν ἡμῶν ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων εἰς τὸ λατρεύειν Θεῷ ζῶντι
verses.transliteration: posō mallon to haima tou Christou hos dia Pneumatos aiōniou heauton prosēnenken amōmon tō Theō kathariei tēn syneidēsin hēmōn apo nekrōn ergōn eis to latreuein Theō zōnti
verses.literal: how much more will the blood of Christ who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God purify our consciences from works of death so that we may serve the living God
verses.literalPt: quanto mais o sangue de Cristo, que, pelo Espírito eterno, se ofereceu sem defeito a Deus, purificará a nossa consciência de obras mortas, para servirmos ao Deus vivo!

verses.original: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο διαθήκης καινῆς μεσίτης ἐστίν ὅπως θανάτου γενομένου εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῶν ἐπὶ τῇ πρώτῃ διαθήκῃ παραβάσεων τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν λάβωσιν οἱ κεκλημένοι τῆς αἰωνίου κληρονομίας
verses.transliteration: Kai dia touto diathēkēs kainēs mesitēs estin hopōs thanatou genomenou eis apolytrōsin tōn epi tē prōtē diathēkē parabaseōn tēn epangelian labōsin hoi keklēmenoi tēs aiōniou klēronomias
verses.literal: Therefore . . . Christ is the mediator of a new covenant so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance now that He has died . . . to redeem them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant
verses.literalPt: Por isso, ele é Mediador de uma nova aliança, para que, tendo intervindo a morte para a redenção das transgressões que havia debaixo da primeira aliança, os que têm sido chamados recebam a promessa da eterna herança.

verses.original: Ὅπου γὰρ διαθήκη θάνατον ἀνάγκη φέρεσθαι τοῦ διαθεμένου
verses.transliteration: Hopou gar diathēkē thanaton anankē pheresthai tou diathemenou
verses.literal: In the case of a will it is necessary to establish the death of the one who made it
verses.literalPt: Pois, onde há um testamento, é necessário que intervenha a morte do testador;

verses.original: διαθήκη γὰρ ἐπὶ νεκροῖς βεβαία ἐπεὶ μή‿ ποτε ἰσχύει ὅτε ζῇ ὁ διαθέμενος
verses.transliteration: diathēkē gar epi nekrois bebaia epei mē pote ischyei hote zē ho diathemenos
verses.literal: because a will does not take effect until the one who made it has died it cannot be executed while he is still alive
verses.literalPt: pois um testamento não tem força senão pela morte, visto que nunca tem valor enquanto o testador vive.

verses.original: Ὅθεν οὐδὲ ἡ πρώτη χωρὶς αἵματος ἐνκεκαίνισται
verses.transliteration: Hothen oude hē prōtē chōris haimatos enkekainistai
verses.literal: That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood
verses.literalPt: Por isso, nem a primeira aliança foi celebrada sem sangue.

verses.original: λαληθείσης γὰρ πάσης ἐντολῆς κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑπὸ Μωϋσέως παντὶ τῷ λαῷ λαβὼν τὸ αἷμα τῶν μόσχων καὶ τῶν τράγων μετὰ ὕδατος καὶ ἐρίου κοκκίνου καὶ ὑσσώπου αὐτό τε τὸ βιβλίον καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν ἐράντισεν
verses.transliteration: lalētheisēs gar pasēs entolēs kata ton nomon hypo Mōuseōs panti tō laō labōn to haima tōn moschōn kai tōn tragōn meta hydatos kai eriou kokkinou kai hyssōpou auto te to biblion kai panta ton laon erantisen
verses.literal: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people he took the blood of calves and goats along with water scarlet wool and hyssop and sprinkled the scroll and all the people
verses.literalPt: Pois, quando Moisés havia falado a todo o povo todos os mandamentos segundo a Lei, tomou o sangue dos bezerros e dos bodes, com água e lã tinta de escarlata e hissopo e aspergiu não só o próprio livro como também a todo o povo,

verses.original: λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης ἧς ἐνετείλατο πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: legōn Touto to haima tēs diathēkēs hēs eneteilato pros hymas ho Theos
verses.literal: saying This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you to keep
verses.literalPt: dizendo: Este é o sangue da aliança, que Deus ordenou para vós.

verses.original: Καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν δὲ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας τῷ αἵματι ὁμοίως ἐράντισεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tēn skēnēn de kai panta ta skeuē tēs leitourgias tō haimati homoiōs erantisen
verses.literal: In the same way he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship
verses.literalPt: Também, da mesma maneira, aspergiu o tabernáculo e todos os vasos do serviço sagrado.

verses.original: καὶ σχεδὸν ἐν αἵματι πάντα καθαρίζεται κατὰ τὸν νόμον καὶ χωρὶς αἱματεκχυσίας οὐ γίνεται ἄφεσις
verses.transliteration: kai schedon en haimati panta katharizetai kata ton nomon kai chōris haimatekchysias ou ginetai aphesis
verses.literal: According to the law in fact nearly everything must be purified with blood and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness
verses.literalPt: Segundo a Lei, quase todas as coisas são purificadas com sangue, e, sem derramamento de sangue, não há remissão.

verses.original: Ἀνάγκη οὖν τὰ μὲν ὑποδείγματα τῶν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς τούτοις καθαρίζεσθαι αὐτὰ δὲ τὰ ἐπουράνια κρείττοσιν θυσίαις παρὰ ταύτας
verses.transliteration: Anankē oun ta men hypodeigmata tōn en tois ouranois toutois katharizesthai auta de ta epourania kreittosin thysiais para tautas
verses.literal: So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these
verses.literalPt: Era necessário, portanto, que as figuras das coisas celestiais fossem purificadas com tais sacrifícios, mas as mesmas coisas celestiais, com sacrifícios melhores que estes.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ εἰς χειροποίητα εἰσῆλθεν ἅγια Χριστός ἀντίτυπα τῶν ἀληθινῶν ἀλλ’ εἰς αὐτὸν τὸν οὐρανόν νῦν ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ προσώπῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: ou gar eis cheiropoiēta eisēlthen hagia Christos antitypa tōn alēthinōn all’ eis auton ton ouranon nyn emphanisthēnai tō prosōpō tou Theou hyper hēmōn
verses.literal: For Christ did not enter . . . . . . a man-made copy of the true sanctuary but He entered heaven itself now to appear on our behalf . . . in the presence of God
verses.literalPt: Pois Cristo não entrou num santo lugar feito por mãos de homens, figura do verdadeiro, mas no mesmo céu, para, agora, aparecer diante de Deus por nós;

verses.original: οὐδ’ ἵνα πολλάκις προσφέρῃ ἑαυτόν ὥσπερ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὰ ἅγια κατ’ ἐνιαυτὸν ἐν αἵματι ἀλλοτρίῳ
verses.transliteration: oud’ hina pollakis prospherē heauton hōsper ho archiereus eiserchetai eis ta hagia kat’ eniauton en haimati allotriō
verses.literal: Nor did He enter heaven to offer Himself again and again as the high priest enters . . . the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own
verses.literalPt: nem a fim de se oferecer muitas vezes a si mesmo, como o sumo sacerdote entra no Santo Lugar de ano em ano com sangue alheio;

verses.original: Ἐπεὶ ἔδει αὐτὸν πολλάκις παθεῖν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου νυνὶ δὲ ἅπαξ ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς ἀθέτησιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας διὰ τῆς θυσίας αὐτοῦ πεφανέρωται
verses.transliteration: Epei edei auton pollakis pathein apo katabolēs kosmou nyni de hapax epi synteleia tōn aiōnōn eis athetēsin tēs hamartias dia tēs thysias autou pephanerōtai
verses.literal: Otherwise Christ would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world But now He has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of Himself
verses.literalPt: de outra forma, lhe seria necessário ter sofrido muitas vezes desde o fundamento do mundo; mas, agora, tem sido manifestado uma vez para sempre na consumação dos séculos, para abolição do pecado pelo sacrifício de si mesmo.

verses.original: Καὶ καθ’ ὅσον ἀπόκειται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἅπαξ ἀποθανεῖν μετὰ δὲ τοῦτο κρίσις
verses.transliteration: Kai kath’ hoson apokeitai tois anthrōpois hapax apothanein meta de touto krisis
verses.literal: Just as man is appointed to die once and after that to face judgment
verses.literalPt: Porquanto é ordenado aos homens que morram uma só vez (e, depois disso, vem o juízo),

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός ἅπαξ προσενεχθεὶς εἰς τὸ πολλῶν ἀνενεγκεῖν ἁμαρτίας ἐκ δευτέρου χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας ὀφθήσεται τοῖς αὐτὸν ἀπεκδεχομένοις εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai ho Christos hapax prosenechtheis eis to pollōn anenenkein hamartias ek deuterou chōris hamartias ophthēsetai tois auton apekdechomenois eis sōtērian
verses.literal: so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many and He will appear a second time not to bear sin but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him
verses.literalPt: assim também Cristo, tendo sido imolado uma vez para sempre, a fim de levar os pecados de muitos, aparecerá segunda vez, sem pecado, aos que o aguardam para a salvação.
